name: exportsIntroduced

versions.rationale: Counts the exports a commit added to the files in scope, deleted since or not, so backfill can tell a one-unit commit from a large one whose other exports were removed later (ADR 0022, #64). Renames are read against the old name, and counting stops at a limit, since backfill only needs to know whether it was more than one.

docs:
How many exports a commit added to the files in scope, counting ones deleted since: each file it added, changed
or renamed is read as the commit left it and as its parent had it (under its old name, for a rename), and an export
is new when the parent's file had none of that name and kind. A root commit's every export is new. Counting stops
at `atMost`.
